payload.task_text:
Our finance team needs to plan the travel budget for sending eight employees from Beijing to Shanghai for a business conference on March 10, 2026. Please look up all available high-speed trains on the Beijing to Shanghai route for that date and retrieve their seat class options with prices.

Create an Excel workbook called Travel_Budget.xlsx in the workspace. Add a sheet called Seat_Options that lists all seat classes across all available Beijing-to-Shanghai trains on March 10, 2026, with the following columns: Train_Code, Seat_Class, Price_Per_Ticket_CNY, Available_Seats. Each train and seat class combination should have its own row.

Add a second sheet called Budget_Scenarios with three scenarios for sending eight people. Each scenario row should have columns: Scenario, Train_Code, Seat_Class, Price_Per_Person, Total_Cost_8_People. Define three scenarios: first, the Budget scenario using second class on the cheapest available Beijing-Shanghai train (find the train code and price from the seat options you retrieved); second, the Standard scenario using first class on the recommended mid-morning train, which is the G1 train departing at 09:00 (find its first class price from your data); third, the Premium scenario using business class on that same G1 train (find the price from your data). Calculate Total_Cost_8_People as Price_Per_Person multiplied by 8 for each row.

Add a third sheet called Summary with columns Label and Value. Include these rows in order: Cheapest_Scenario (the scenario name with the lowest total cost), Most_Expensive_Scenario (the scenario name with the highest total cost), Price_Difference_CNY (the difference between the most expensive and cheapest total cost), Budget_Total_8_People (the Budget scenario total), Standard_Total_8_People (the Standard scenario total), Premium_Total_8_People (the Premium scenario total).

All numeric values in the workbook (prices, totals, and the price difference) must be written as literal numbers, not Excel formulas.

Create a survey form titled "Business Trip Travel Preference Survey" with exactly three questions. The first question should be a multiple choice question asking "Which train departure time do you prefer?" with options listing each available Beijing-Shanghai train's departure time and code, for example "07:00 - G11" and "09:00 - G1". The second question should be a multiple choice question asking "What is your preferred seat class?" with options: Second Class, First Class, and Business Class. The third question should be a text question asking "Any special travel requirements or comments?".

Send an email to finance@company.com with the subject "Travel Budget Analysis for Beijing-Shanghai Conference". The email body should include the three scenario totals for 8 people: Budget total, Standard total, and Premium total, and the price difference between the most and least expensive scenarios.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, the main agent must complete the task directly and must not dispatch a sub-agent. This route inventory is small and all three outputs depend on the same train options, so delegation adds handoffs without shortening the path.

Query the rail service for Beijing South (VNP) to Shanghai Hongqiao (SHH) on 2026-03-10 and retain every high-speed train plus every returned seat class, literal price and availability. Verify the G1 09:00 row and its first/business-class prices; choose the Budget scenario as the cheapest available second-class train with a deterministic earliest-departure tie-break. Compute all eight-person totals and summary differences once.

Resolve the actual task workspace dynamically. Create Travel_Budget.xlsx once with exact Seat_Options, Budget_Scenarios and Summary sheets/order, literal numeric values and complete read-back. Then create Business Trip Travel Preference Survey once: first choice options are every available departure formatted HH:MM - Train_Code, second choices exactly Second Class/First Class/Business Class, third a text question; call get_form once and do not retry create after ambiguity. Finally paginate Sent search for finance@company.com plus exact subject Travel Budget Analysis for Beijing-Shanghai Conference, send at most once with all three totals and price difference, and read it back. Reconcile the workbook/form/email to the same frozen route inventory and finish without an audit wave.

Create an Excel workbook at the exact path:
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-train-budget-excel-gform-email/workspace/Travel_Budget.xlsx

Use the mcp__excel__* tools. The workbook must contain exactly three worksheets with the exact names and data below. All numeric values must be written as literal numbers (e.g., 349, 553, 1748.5, 2792), NOT Excel formulas.

Sheet 1 — name: "Seat_Options"
Headers (row 1): Train_Code | Seat_Class | Price_Per_Ticket_CNY | Available_Seats
Rows (data, starting row 2):
G11 | Business Class | 1748.5 | 0
G11 | First Class | 553 | 999
G11 | Second Class | 349 | 999
G1 | Business Class | 1748.5 | 3
G1 | First Class | 553 | 12
G1 | Second Class | 349 | 999

Note on Available_Seats: "有票" (tickets available with no specific count) is represented as 999; G1 Business has 3 remaining, G1 First has 12 remaining, G11 Business has none (0).

Sheet 2 — name: "Budget_Scenarios"
Headers (row 1): Scenario | Train_Code | Seat_Class | Price_Per_Person | Total_Cost_8_People
Rows (data, starting row 2):
Budget | G11 | Second Class | 349 | 2792
Standard | G1 | First Class | 553 | 4424
Premium | G1 | Business Class | 1748.5 | 13988
(Total_Cost_8_People is literally the pre-computed number, no formula.)

Sheet 3 — name: "Summary"
Headers (row 1): Label | Value
Rows (data, starting row 2, in this exact order):
Cheapest_Scenario | Budget
Most_Expensive_Scenario | Premium
Price_Difference_CNY | 11196
Budget_Total_8_People | 2792
Standard_Total_8_People | 4424
Premium_Total_8_People | 13988

Implementation notes:
- When you create the workbook, a default sheet is auto-created. Rename it to "Seat_Options" (or delete it and create fresh sheets) so the final file has exactly these three sheets: Seat_Options, Budget_Scenarios, Summary.
- Write headers and all rows as plain values. Do not use apply_formula anywhere.
- After building, verify by reading back the workbook metadata and the data from each sheet, and confirm the file exists at the given path.

Report back: the absolute file path, confirmation that all three sheets exist with the exact headers/rows, and that all numeric values are literal numbers.
Build Travel_Budget.xlsx workbook

Create a Google Form using the mcp__google_forms__* tools with EXACTLY the following specification.

Form title: "Business Trip Travel Preference Survey"
(No description is required, but you may leave it empty.)

The form must have exactly three questions, added in this order:

1. Multiple choice question:
   Title: "Which train departure time do you prefer?"
   Options (exactly two, in this order): "07:00 - G11", "09:00 - G1"

2. Multiple choice question:
   Title: "What is your preferred seat class?"
   Options (exactly three, in this order): "Second Class", "First Class", "Business Class"

3. Text question:
   Title: "Any special travel requirements or comments?"

Do NOT add any extra questions, options, or fields. Do not change titles or option text.

Report back: the form ID, the form title, and the full list of questions (titles and options) as created, confirming all three questions match the spec exactly.
